requirements_joint.source: 三项共同要求（与实验总览一致）
requirements_joint.en: Shared requirement for all three metrics (same as overview)

requirements_joint_threshold.en: Minimum retention for all three metrics (%)

requirements_joint_summary.source: 三项共同要求：场重建、幅度和定位效用保留率均不低于{{0}}%。
requirements_joint_summary.en: Shared requirement: field reconstruction, amplitude, and localization utility retention must each be at least {{0}}%.

requirements_note.source: 修改要求只重新判断现有指标，不启动计算。自定义模式下，留空的指标不参与判定。
requirements_note.en: Changing requirements only reassesses existing metrics; it does not start a computation. Blank limits are not checked in individual mode.

requirements_guide.source: 已有结果、布局设计和方案对比默认要求三项保留率都达到同一最低要求，G为三项最低值。方案对比和坐标评价可切换为自定义要求，分别设置场重建、幅度、定位效用或毫米误差上限；留空的指标不参与判定。修改要求只重新判断已有数值，不改变点位、不重新计算。
requirements_guide.en: Results, Layout Design, and Compare Layouts require all three retention metrics to meet the same minimum by default; G is their minimum. Compare Layouts and coordinate evaluation can use individual limits for field reconstruction, amplitude, localization utility, or error in millimeters. Blank limits are not checked. Changing requirements only reassesses existing values; it does not move electrodes or rerun computation.
